description: This file contains a PHP test class GetModuleCest within the namespace Test\Api\V8. It uses Codeception testing framework to test API endpoints for module retrieval in the V8 API version. The class includes setup, positive, and negative test cases for various API responses related to module 'Accounts'. The tests involve sending HTTP GET requests, verifying response codes and contents, and cleaning up created data.
